options: Only the monitoring of models already in production
The whole journey of a machine learning model, from the availability of raw data until the model is deployed in production
The provisioning of servers for data scientists
The design of dashboards for model results
questions.explanation: MLOps, Machine Learning Operations, is the end-to-end journey from raw data being available to the ML model being deployed in PROD.

questions.stem: Roughly what proportion of machine learning models are said never to reach production?
questions.explanation: In the machine learning world 90% of models do not go to production; most are created, trained and decommissioned.

questions.stem: What vital role does CI/CD play in MLOps?
options: Moving models between the development and training areas again and again, and to production once the owner confirms
Replacing the need for model validation
questions.explanation: CI/CD repeatedly moves models from development to training, and once confirmed by the owner, moves them to PROD.

questions.stem: From which concept was MLOps extracted?
questions.explanation: MLOps was extracted from the concept of DevOps and follows the same pattern with a different agenda.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT part of the Model Development phase of MLOps?
questions.explanation: Model Development covers Problem Definition, Data Selection, Data Exploration, Data Wrangling, Model Preparation and Model Validation; Smoke Test belongs to Training and Operationalisation.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed under the Prediction Serving phase of MLOps?
questions.explanation: Prediction Serving includes Online, Batch, Streaming and Embedded Inference plus Explain Predictions; Data Drift is part of Continuous Monitoring.

questions.stem: What does the Continuous Monitoring phase of MLOps watch for?
options: Data Drift, Concept Drift and Continuous Drift
Code coverage and unit test results
questions.explanation: Continuous Monitoring tracks Data Drift, Concept Drift and Continuous Drift.

questions.stem: Which steps make up the Continuous Training phase of MLOps?
options: Build, Test and Deployment to Production
Data Ingestion, Data Validation, Data Transformation, Model Training, Model Evaluation, Model Validation and Model Registration
questions.explanation: Continuous Training runs from Data Ingestion through Validation and Transformation to Model Training, Evaluation, Validation and Registration.

questions.stem: From where are the key phases of MLOps said to be taken?
options: The ISO software life cycle standard
Best practice on Databricks, Google and a few other places
questions.explanation: The key phases are taken from best practice published by Databricks, Google and a few other sources.

questions.stem: MLOps is described as belonging to the same family as which other practices?
questions.explanation: MLOps comes from the same family as DevOps, DevSecOps and DataOps, with its own focus on machine learning models.
